verdict: Organic engagement is softening across all three locations this period.
narrative: Across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals, your Google Business Profiles were the only active channels this period, combining for 370 total actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — with no paid spend running on any brand. GBP engagement dropped meaningfully in the most recent 7 days on all three profiles (down 57%, 44%, and 35% respectively versus the prior 7 days), a consistent softening signal that points to reduced local search visibility rather than isolated noise. Two of the O'Hare-group listings generated zero calls despite registering impressions all period, and a listing audit is underway to address that conversion gap. On the infrastructure side, several CRM and web/SEO milestones that were due in July and August remain open, and clearing those blockers is the current operational priority so that paid campaigns and outreach sequences can launch on schedule. The Sep 30 milestone — contact sequences and a CRM parser fix — is the next firm target, and progress against it will be reflected in next week's report.
